verdicts.reason: Both blow the white card up to nearly fill the canvas, so the pop-art shapes shrink to meaningless slivers at the edges and the brand feel is mostly lost. Both also wrap the headline badly, leaving 'can' as an orphan. A packs the logo, headline and CTA tightly, and its CTA sits almost on the card's bottom edge. B has slightly more even vertical spacing and a bit more room under the CTA, but the same structural flaws.
